notes.A: A counter and the bookshop frame the hall, but the bright canister steals attention.
notes.B: Shopfronts recede down the arcade, but the foreground skeleton overwhelms them.
notes.C: A robed figure stands among shop bays, but the bookshop sign is clipped.
notes.D: The clock and bookshop anchor the arcade, though the middle feels bare.
notes.E: The clock shop and checkerboard thresholds read clearly, but the head-on view flattens the arcade.
notes.F: The broad concourse connects several shops, but their signs and wares are hard to read.
notes.G: The clock shop’s sign and shelves dominate, leaving little of the wider arcade visible.
notes.H: Brick piers frame a robed figure, but conceal most of the arcade.

arcade.best: D ties the oversized clock, BOOKS storefront, patterned concourse, and skeletons into one readable view.
arcade.lacks: The concourse lacks a focal point at eye level. The shops recede into a continuous band of dark brown trim, leaving the patterned floor to dominate.
arcade.fix: Put a warmly lit clockmaker’s kiosk with a tall working clock in the open concourse, leaving a clear route around it.

blind_name.name: Ornate hallway beside a library
blind_name.why: A large wall clock and patterned floor frame a doorway into a room lined with bookshelves and lit by candles.
blind_name.odd: The clock is clipped at the left edge, and the framed picture is hard to make out.
